text: This report requests that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 225 Douglas Drive. The application indicates the reason for removal is due to conflict with a proposed swimming pool. The subject tree is a 'Crimson King' Norway maple (Acer platanoides) measuring 40 cm in diameter. The Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
City Council on December 16, 17 and 18, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 225 Douglas Drive.
